_doc: The Battle Tower island's buildings (the tower, res 473; the PWT's entrance on the east lawn, res 488, whose door B2_ZONE_192 leads into Black 2's PWT lobby: data/hoenn_map_additions.json) and props (warp-only map: group 'standalone', its own exterior pack, data/buildings/standalone.json, b2tools/models_standalone.py). buildings: Sapphire door destination -> res and front (z of the model's front wall; world.py puts it 4 units into the door tile, footprint centre from data/plans); props: model origin in Sapphire map tile coordinates (footprint centre x, door row + (4 - 20)/16 for a building), 'covers': map tile rects the model stands on (no ground-module plinths there).
